config.description: Config is passed through to the Consul agent configuration as is.

log_level.description: LogLevel of the agent: trace, debug, info, warn or error.

consul.description: Consul checks the cluster through the dc's servers.

exec.description:
Exec passes when the command exits 0 (and its output contains
output:, if set).

within.description: Within is how long to keep retrying, e.g. 20s; default once.

ip.description: IP address of the node on this network.

ConfigEntry.description: ConfigEntry is a Consul config entry, passed through as is.

defaults.description: Defaults apply to every datacenter unless it overrides them.

templates.description:
Templates are reusable node shapes, keyed by name; a node takes one
with from: NAME and overrides fields after it.

federation.description:
Federation joins the datacenters' servers over a generated `wan`
network. Without it, datacenters are independent clusters.

peering.description:
Peering connects datacenters as cluster peers, keyed by peering name
(the peer's name on both sides, e.g. dc1-dc2). Needs Consul 1.14+ and
a mesh gateway in each peered datacenter for service traffic.

dc.description: DC to check; default: the only datacenter.

leader.description: Leader: the dc has a raft leader.

peers.description: Peers, e.g. ">=3": raft peers (voters and non-voters).

service_healthy.description: ServiceHealthy: at least one instance of the service passes.

addr.description:
Addr of the agent's HTTP API inside the node; default 127.0.0.1:8500
(127.0.0.1:8501 with ca_file).

leader.description: Leader: a raft leader is known.

members.description: Members, e.g. ">=4": alive LAN members seen by this agent.

wan_members.description:
WANMembers, e.g. ">=6": alive WAN members (servers of every
federated datacenter) seen by this server.

service_healthy.description: ServiceHealthy: this node's instance of the service is passing in the catalog.

reaches.description:
Reaches: the agent can read this datacenter's catalog (cross-dc RPC
works from the agent's datacenter to it).

partition.description: Partition and Namespace scope ServiceHealthy (Consul Enterprise).

token.description: Token for the agent API when ACLs are on.

ca_file.description:
CAFile turns on HTTPS (default address 127.0.0.1:8501) and verifies
the agent with this CA; a relative path is in the node's directory.

agents.description: Agents settings apply to servers and clients alike.

server.description: Server settings apply to Consul servers only.

client.description: Client settings apply to client agents only.

service_defaults.description: ServiceDefaults are merged into every service.

acl.description:
ACL turns on ACLs (default deny) and gossip encryption. Parker
generates the management and agent tokens and the gossip key; `parker
exec` sets CONSUL_HTTP_TOKEN. Federated datacenters must agree.

tls.description:
TLS turns on mutual TLS for RPC and HTTPS-only APIs (port 8501),
with a CA Parker generates per lab. Clients get their certificates
through auto_encrypt. `parker exec` sets CONSUL_HTTP_ADDR and
CONSUL_CACERT. Federated datacenters must agree.

primary.description: Primary marks the primary datacenter (for federation and ACLs).

subnet.description:
Subnet of the datacenter LAN, e.g. 10.1.0.0/24; picked automatically
if empty.

ui.description: UI enables the Consul web UI on the servers.

overrides.description: Per-server settings, keyed by server name (server-1, server-2, ...).

servers.description: Servers is the number of Consul servers, or {count, overrides}.

nodes.description:
Nodes besides the servers, keyed by name. A node runs a client agent
by default, plus its services and processes.

kind.description: Gateway kind; default: the gateway's name.

entry.description: The gateway's config entry in Consul casing, without Kind and Name (Listeners, Services, ...).

wan.description: Mesh gateways: attach to the wan network (default: on when federated).

additionalProperties.description: true for a gateway with defaults, or {kind, count, wan, entry}.

gateways.description:
Gateways are nodes that run a Consul agent and a gateway Envoy,
keyed by node name: mesh: true, or {kind, count, wan}.

partitions.description:
Partitions are Admin Partitions (Consul Enterprise), keyed by name.
A dc has either nodes: and gateways: (the default partition) or
partitions: (put default-partition nodes under partitions.default).

config_entries.description:
ConfigEntries are applied in order once the datacenter's servers
(and ACLs) are ready. Each is an entry in Consul's own casing, pasted
from the docs, or {file: path} to an HCL or JSON file relative to
this YAML file.

on.description: On is a selector; the command runs on every node it matches.

run.description:
Run is the command: a string runs with sh -c (pipes and quotes
work), a list runs as is.

allow_failure.description: AllowFailure keeps going when the command exits non-zero.

message.description: Message is the body of every response (MESSAGE).

version.description: Version labels responses, e.g. v2 for a canary subset (VERSION).

upstreams.description:
Upstreams the service calls on each request, as URIs
(UPSTREAM_URIS). Default: the service's upstreams: through its
sidecar, http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

workers.description:
Workers is how many upstreams are called at once (UPSTREAM_WORKERS);
default 1, in order.

upstream_failure.description:
UpstreamFailure is fail (default: answer 500 when an upstream
fails) or ignore.

health.description: Health sets what /health answers; Parker's http check uses it.

ready.description: Ready sets what /ready answers; Parker waits on it at up.

Fake.description: Fake configures Parker's built-in fake service.

code.description:
Code /health answers (HEALTH_CHECK_RESPONSE_CODE); default 200. A
code of 400 or more fails the Consul check while the process keeps
running.

delay.description:
Delay before /ready passes, from the start of the process
(READY_CHECK_RESPONSE_DELAY), e.g. 5s: a slow-starting service.

mode.description:
Mode is wan (serf WAN gossip between servers on the wan network) or
mesh-gateways (servers reach each other through the datacenters'
mesh gateways; needs tls and a mesh gateway per datacenter).

url.description: URL to request from inside the node's namespace.

module.description: Module is a module file's path, relative to the importing file.

Import.description: Import is one module to merge in.

agents.description: Agents settings apply to servers and clients alike.

server.description: Server settings apply to Consul servers only.

client.description: Client settings apply to client agents only.

service_defaults.description: ServiceDefaults are merged into every service.

acl.description:
ACL turns on ACLs (default deny) and gossip encryption. Parker
generates the management and agent tokens and the gossip key; `parker
exec` sets CONSUL_HTTP_TOKEN. Federated datacenters must agree.

tls.description:
TLS turns on mutual TLS for RPC and HTTPS-only APIs (port 8501),
with a CA Parker generates per lab. Clients get their certificates
through auto_encrypt. `parker exec` sets CONSUL_HTTP_ADDR and
CONSUL_CACERT. Federated datacenters must agree.

Inheritable.description: Inheritable holds the settings that flow down the tree.

file.description: File is the license file: absolute, ~/..., or relative to this file.

License.description: License points at a Consul Enterprise license file.

gateway.description: Gateway is the host-side bridge address; default the subnet's .1.

from.description:
From names a template under consul.templates; the node's own fields
win over the template's.

count.description: Count makes N copies of the node, named <name>-1 ... <name>-N.

agent.description:
Agent is client (default), dataplane (no agent: services are
registered in the catalog and each sidecar is consul-dataplane, which
talks to the servers) or none.

config.description: Config is merged into this node's agent configuration.

meta.description: Meta is the node's Consul node metadata.

service.description: Service is shorthand for one service named after the node.

services.description: Services run on this node, keyed by service name.

processes.description: Processes are extra processes on this node, keyed by name.

name.description: Name of the node within its dc, e.g. server-2 or web-1.

role.description: Role is server, client, gateway or none (no agent).

group.description: Group is the node's entry under nodes: (web for web-1, web-2, ...).

partition.description:
Partition the node's agent is in (Enterprise; "" outside
partitions:).

namespaces.description: Namespaces of the node's services, besides the default (Enterprise).

NodeLabels.description: NodeLabels place a node in the consul: tree.

client.description: Client settings apply to this partition's client agents.

service_defaults.description: ServiceDefaults are merged into this partition's services.

nodes.description:
Nodes in this partition, keyed by name. Node names are unique
across a datacenter's partitions.

kind.description: Gateway kind; default: the gateway's name.

entry.description: The gateway's config entry in Consul casing, without Kind and Name (Listeners, Services, ...).

wan.description: Mesh gateways: attach to the wan network (default: on when federated).

additionalProperties.description: true for a gateway with defaults, or {kind, count, wan, entry}.

gateways.description: Gateways in this partition (mesh gateways are per partition).

config_entries.description: ConfigEntries are written into this partition, after the dc's.

Partition.description: Partition is an Admin Partition (Consul Enterprise): Parker creates it, joins its nodes' client agents to it and writes its config entries into it.

dialer.description: Dialer establishes the peering with the token.

via_mesh_gateways.description:
ViaMeshGateways sends the peering's control plane through the mesh
gateways (mesh config entry PeerThroughMeshGateways); otherwise the
dialer's servers reach the acceptor's on the wan network.

exports.description:
Exports lists, per datacenter (acceptor or dialer), the services it
exports to the other side (sugar for an exported-services entry).

Peering.description: Peering is one cluster peering between two datacenters.

run.description:
Run is the command. The first word may name a versioned binary
(e.g. "consul"), which is resolved from `versions:` or Version.

version.description: Version overrides versions.<binary> for this process.

uses.description:
Uses names other pinned binaries the process runs (consul connect
envoy starts envoy); they are fetched and put on PATH.

depends_on.description:
DependsOn lists processes to wait for, keyed by "<node>/<process>"
(or "<process>" on the same node).

ready_when.description: ReadyWhen says when the process counts as ready.

restart.description:
Restart is no (default), on-failure or always. It applies once the lab
is up, and only while `parker daemon` supervises the lab.

networks.description: Networks the node joins, keyed by network name.

files.description:
Files to write before start: path (relative to the node dir) to
content.

processes.description: Processes run in the node's namespace, keyed by name.

labels.description:
Labels say where an expanded node came from; selectors such as
dc1/servers and svc:api match on them.

port.description: Port: ready once this TCP port accepts connections.

http.description: HTTP: ready once this URL answers with the expected status.

log.description: Log: ready once the process log contains this text.

consul.description: Consul: ready once the agent reports this state.

steps.description: Steps run in order; a failing step ends the scenario.

on_failure.description:
OnFailure: keep (default) leaves the lab running for a look, teardown
takes it down.

version.description: Version of Consul for this server, e.g. for upgrade tests.

config.description: Config is merged into this server's agent configuration.

run.description: Run is fake-service (Parker's built-in fake service) or a command.

check.description: Check is the health check: http, tcp or none.

register.description: Register is merged into the Consul service registration as is.

namespace.description:
Namespace the service registers in (Consul Enterprise); Parker
creates it. Default: the default namespace.

connect.description:
Connect puts the service in the mesh: sidecar registers a sidecar
proxy and runs Envoy for it (needs versions.envoy); tproxy does the
same as a transparent proxy, redirecting the node's traffic through
Envoy (one per node, needs iptables); none (default) leaves it out.

dc.description: DC of the destination, when not the caller's.

peer.description: Peer the destination is imported from (cluster peering).

additionalProperties.description: A local port, or {port, dc, peer, partition, namespace}.

upstreams.description:
Upstreams the sidecar binds on 127.0.0.1, keyed by destination
service: api: 9091, or {port, dc, peer, partition, namespace}.

at.description:
At delays the step: +30s after the previous step finished, or T+30s
after the scenario started.

name.description: Name labels the step in the output.

wait.description: Wait for nodes to be ready: "dc1 ready", or any selector.

exec.description:
Exec runs a command on one or more nodes; a non-zero exit fails the
step unless allow_failure is set.

assert.description: Assert checks a condition, retried until within: runs out.

snapshot.description: Snapshot copies state aside for later: logs.

items.description: A selector, or a list of selectors.

partition.description:
Partition cuts the network between groups of nodes, each a selector
or a list of them: [dc1, dc2], or [[dc1/server-1, dc1/server-2],
[dc1/server-3]]. One group is cut off from the rest of the lab.
Packets between the sides are dropped until heal.

heal.description:
Heal removes partitions: all, or a selector (every cut to or from
its nodes).

kill.description:
Kill SIGKILLs the processes of the nodes a selector matches; the
restart policy applies, as to a crash.

stop.description:
Stop stops the nodes' processes (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 10s)
and keeps them down until start.

start.description:
Start starts the nodes' processes that aren't running and waits for
their readiness checks.

pause.description: Pause freezes the nodes' processes (SIGSTOP) until resume.

upgrade.description:
Upgrade moves the nodes to another version of a pinned binary, one
node at a time: servers before clients, the leader last, each one
healthy again before the next.

Step.description: Step is one action, optionally delayed with at:.

on.description: On is a selector: dc1/servers, dc1, ...

to.description: To is the version to run, e.g. 1.22.8.

binary.description: Binary is the pinned binary to swap; default consul.

parker.description: Parker is the schema version of this file.

name.description:
Name of the lab; defaults to the file name. Lowercase letters, digits
and '-', at most 24 characters.

versions.description:
Versions of the binaries to fetch, e.g. {consul: 1.22.7}. Add "+ent"
for Enterprise builds.

license.description:
License is the Consul Enterprise license for "+ent" versions. Without
it Parker reads CONSUL_LICENSE_PATH, then CONSUL_LICENSE. The license
goes to the agents only; it never appears in expand output or logs.

vars.description:
Vars are substituted wherever ${vars.NAME} appears; override with
--var NAME=VALUE. ${env.NAME} reads the environment.

imports.description:
Imports merge module files under this one: a module's provides:
comes first, so this file's own values win.

consul.description: Consul is the high-level description: datacenters, nodes, services.

networks.description: Networks are extra low-level bridges, keyed by name.

nodes.description:
Nodes are low-level network namespaces running arbitrary processes,
keyed by name. They may join generated <dc>-lan networks.

scenario.description: Scenario is the steps `parker run FILE` plays against the lab.

scenarios.description: Scenarios are named ones: `parker run FILE NAME`.
